name: Approval Dialog Node
description: Adds a workflow node that shows a plugin-requested dialog (ctx.ui.showDialog) asking the user to approve or reject the run, with an optional comment.

nodes.label: Approval Gate
nodes.description: Pauses the run behind a plugin-shown dialog; fails when the user rejects or cancels.

fields.label: Question
fields.description: Shown as the dialog message; {{variables}} are substituted.

fields.label: Comment variable
fields.description: Runtime variable that receives the approver's comment.
